name: Picture
overview: Scripture clearly warns against the creation and worship of pictures or images as idols, emphasizing God's command to avoid graven images or standing stones for idolatry, as seen in Leviticus 26:1 and Numbers 33:52. At the same time, the Bible uses the imagery of pictures metaphorically to convey the beauty and value of wise speech, likening a well-spoken word to apples of gold in pictures of silver (Proverbs 25:11). Additionally, the term 'pictures' can describe desirable or pleasant objects, highlighting God's awareness of the physical and symbolic significance of images (Isaiah 2:16). Thus, the biblical teaching balances a prohibition against idolatrous images with recognition of the illustrative and expressive power of pictures.
